principalConclusion: ARA research and analytics must be governed by versioned questions, protocols and conditions. Observable events and instruments become evidence only when explicitly authorized; measures, constructs, interpretations and interventions remain separate. Personal, teaching, research and operational analytics have independent authority, visibility and retention.
acceptedDecisions: Adopt the conceptual object model in issue5-research-framework-v1.json.
Use a minimal internal event vocabulary with versioned mappings to Caliper/xAPI rather than adopting either as the ARA domain.
Require a question, formula, unit, denominator, window, missing-data rule, limitation and permitted use for every measure.
Represent quantitative, qualitative, mixed-method and development-research instruments.
Make purpose binding, minimization, rights, identity mode, retention, access and export protocol-level rules.
Keep personal analytics opt-in/private by default and separate from teaching/research visibility.
Separate operational telemetry and incident data from educational analytics.
Require immutable condition snapshots and explicit deviation/fidelity records.
Require semantic conformance evidence before cross-deployment pooling.
Use role-oriented analytics questions rather than a universal dashboard.
deferred: Predictive early warning and automated interventions
Choice of LRS, warehouse or analytics database

Issue6: Adopt Protocol, Condition, Participant, Assignment, EventDefinition, InstrumentDefinition, MeasureDefinition, ConstructDefinition, InterpretationRule, EvidenceRecord and ResearchPackage as normative domain concepts.
Integrate research objects with configuration/content/composition snapshots and lifecycle.
Issue7: Design ports/adapters for authorized events, instruments, research packages, privacy controls and cross-deployment conformance.
Keep baseline personal deployment free from a mandatory central event store.
Issue8: Design protocol builder, consent/withdrawal, instrument schedule, question-oriented analytics and export explanations with role/rights boundaries.
Issue9: Plan synthetic conformance fixtures and privacy/measure formula tests; do not treat them as educational evidence.
